title: Areas We Serve
metaDescription: We serve guests from across Miami-Dade and Broward counties — Miami, Miami Beach, Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Hialeah, South Miami, and Pinecrest.

sections.title: Serving all of South Florida
sections.intro: We pick up and host guests from across Miami-Dade and Broward counties. Our dock is in Miami, and most of our regulars make a half-day of it from anywhere in the metro.
